pitchLegend: The thin line shows the original vocal pitch. The thicker plum line shows input pitch. Capsules mark the target notes, with a tolerance band of 50 cents on either side.
scanLegend: The sweep line marks the fill edge. Long lines mark bars, and short ticks mark beats.
meterLimits: Pitch threshold {pitch} dBFS. Pitch stops at clipping near {clip} dBFS.
historyDescription: Higher levels indicate louder input. Level and pitch share a timeline. The microphone level strip shows pitch status by color.
gainHint: Adjusts the input level used for sing-along analysis.

hz0.label: Off · Preserve low end
hz0.hint: For quiet rooms or practicing low notes.

hz80.label: {hz} Hz · Rumble reduction
hz80.hint: For footsteps, stand vibration, or air-conditioning rumble.

hz120.label: {hz} Hz · Proximity effect
hz120.hint: For excess bass when singing close to a directional mic.

hz180.label: {hz} Hz · Stronger low cut
hz180.hint: For persistent rumble. Turn it down if low notes drop out.

noiseHint: Changing this briefly restarts microphone capture.
noiseUnknown: The device did not report its noise suppression setting.
noiseMismatch: The device did not apply the selected noise suppression setting.
alignmentHint: Moves only the sung pitch trace.
